body: HCLTech on Monday reported a 21.2% year-on-year growth in net profit for the second quarter ended September to Rs 5,132 crore while revenue increased 11.5% to Rs 35,620 crore.The strong numbers guided India’s third largest software services company to raise the lower end of the revenue forecast for the full year ending March 2027.
